'''Howard Tat''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 15th at [[August 2000 Marlton tournament]] on 6 August 2000, according to Pete Flamini's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1135">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-mt-laurel-nj-8-6-00d1135/ mt-laurel-nj-8-6-00], DeckTech (Pete "Ghetto 13" Flamini, 16 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-mt-laurel-nj-8-6-00d1135/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
